text:
margo_marketing: Heads-up team 1 Launchpad announce planned Thu 09:00 PT. Need final changelog URL, canonical staging docs, a short benchmark nugget for hero copy, canary + ramp windows, and webinar/demo ownership (30m). Also want two email subject lines for an A/B test. :rocket:

diego_eng: I'll push final changelog PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelogs/pull/788 (sha `d4a1c9f`). Canary plan: 09:00 PT canary 5m, 25% at 09:05, 60% at 09:12, full at 09:30. Fallback tag `launchpad-legacy`. Ops should watch p95 for 20m after full.

lina_docs: Staging docs are up: https://docs.redwood.dev/staging/launchpad. Added Quickstart + Migration guide; will paste the migration snippet here. Marketing: please use staging link as canonical in draft.

margo_marketing: Thanks Lina. Ravi, any benchmark line we can use without being too aggressive? We might want a short plain-English stat for the blog hero and a slightly more technical sentence for the benchmark section.

ravi_research: Draft hero stat: "Launchpad cuts per-token spend up to 2.2x on long-context apps and lowers p95 latency by ~48% at 16k tokens." Technical line for the bench section: "Adaptive batching + prefix KV caching reduced end-to-end token cost by 2.2x on 16k workloads and improved p95 from ~480ms to ~250ms under representative traffic." Running one more overnight regression; will confirm numbers by 08:00 PT tomorrow. :bar_chart:

margo_marketing: That phrasing looks good. Please confirm by 08:00. Webinar: Evan can you lead? Thinking same day 11:00 PT for 30m (20 demo + 10 Q&A). We'll invite a power user to join the demo if they confirm.

ev an_pm: I can lead. Lina will demo migration, Ravi will own benchmark slides, and I'll own the runbook + rollback steps. Email timing: public email at +5m after full rollout, VIP at +12m, social at +20m. Two subject options for A/B: A) "Launchpad: longer contexts, lower token cost" B) "Meet Launchpad 1 up to 2.2x lower token spend".

diego_eng: Runbook snippet to include: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/reinference --to-revision=7` and post-deploy health check: `curl -sS https://health.prod.redwood.dev/model-route | jq .p95`. Also add a KV cache hit-rate check after +10m.

lina_docs: Migration snippet to paste in docs:```
# launchpad example
model:
  id: redwood-launchpad
  quant_mode: auto
  kv_cache: enabled
```

margo_marketing: Proposed timeline: 09:00 PT canary, 09:30 full, 09:35 blog + staging docs live, 09:40 public email, 09:52 VIP email, 09:55 social posts, 11:00 webinar. We'll schedule a short pre-announce dry-run with Growth at 08:15 PT to sanity check copy.

ravi_research: Regression queued; will post final confirmed numbers by 08:00 PT. If anything changes we'll switch to "up to" language.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: release-launchpad start=1749999000 canary_window=300s full_rollout=1749999800 CI: all checks passed. :white_check_mark:

margo_marketing: Great. I'll draft the announcement copy and drop it here by EOD for review. Final checklist: merged changelog link, staging docs URL, benchmark confirmation, runbook + rollback, webinar deck, email subjects. Ping me with any last-minute changes. :wave:
